sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 500. Deals physical damage 3 times that penetrates any nullifying or invulnerability effects with a success value of 100. (Light).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Frozen for 40 seconds with a success value of 110.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces status ailment resistance value by 100 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Status ailment resistance value boosted by 60 for 120 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Armament for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases ATK and MATK by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 30000
Confuse and Prohibit Unison Resistance Up by 60

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies blessing (recovers 50 Cost, increases max HP by 100%, nullifies status ailments and Unison Gauge reduction effects, reduces cooldown times by 50%, and recovers 20% of max HP every 5 seconds) for 120 seconds.
